name: MST Forward Private
description: Forward a post (with attachments) from a channel, group message, or DM to other users via separate DMs, with a receipt on the source post.

settings.help_text: Allow the Forward to… post menu action.
Maximum users that can be selected in one forward (1–8).
Add a short footer. Channel copies say Forwarded from {name}. Direct and group copies say they came from a private conversation.
Post a thread note on the original message listing who received the forward.
